# PyAutoFit Visualization Gallery

<!-- Generated by gallery/gallery_build.py from scripts/<domain>/images/. Do not edit by hand: rerun `bash gallery/gallery_run.sh --all`. -->

Rendered with PyAutoFit `2026.9.27.2` · 49 figures.

Every figure below is one PyAutoFit draws for a model-fit — the search plots (corner / MLE traces), the model figure, the expectation-propagation graph figures and the `af.ex` example visualizer — rendered from real fits to this repo's 1D Gaussian datasets. See [README.md](README.md) for how to improve one.
